## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON confirmed. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND) and Stocks vs Bonds rising (SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND) provide independent confirmation alongside HYG/LQD support (HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit conditions supportive: HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND → rising. Reflation bid visible: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, yield curve (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -0.34%) → flat BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND — conditions favor risk assets but monitor curve dynamics.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and Tech both leading: XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND; XLY (1W: +3.27% | 1M: -1.90%) in RECOVERY. Style: Growth and Financials sharing leadership, breadth confirms cyclicals participation.

**5. US vs Global?**
Emerging markets outperformed this week: EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND vs SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY — EM strength broad-based.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy: IBIT (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +3.53%) ABOVE TREND; ARKK (1W: +1.06% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY — strong short-term risk tolerance.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation-biased but volatile: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY, GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY. Commodities show mixed signals with notable 1W weakness in some oil plays despite 1M strength.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed and choppy: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND — watch volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND show multi-timeframe strength; HYG/LQD both positive also confirm risk-on. DIVERGENCE: Energy/commodity ETFs (USO (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%) CORRECTION; BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION) show short-term mismatches — minor divergence relative to equity breadth.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and EM exposure (XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND; EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor momentum ETFs (SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to energy/commodity beta and weak natural gas exposure (UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION, IGV (1W: -7.06% | 1M: -12.91%) BELOW TREND, UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY and selective oil exposure if volatility calms (USO (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%) CORRECTION). BEARISH: UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND and short-term oil momentum (BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION) remains fragile.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND — VXX ~30 remains a key fear level. HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD ~0.73 for credit health. XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND vs XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND — XLK/XLF ~2.81 is a style pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and SPY/TLT rising confirm broad risk appetite. Financials, Tech and EM showing relative strength while energy/commodity discord (USO/BNO/XLE) is the key divergence to monitor.
